data.Q: Why does Jehoiada make a covenant with the Lord, the king, and the people?
data.A: So the king and the people will be the Lord’s people.
data.wrong_answer: To post guards at the temple of the Lord.

data.Q: After the people destroy Baal’s temple, what does Jehoiada do at the Lord’s temple?
What happens to Mattan the priest of Baal?
data.A: The people kill Mattan in front of the altars.
data.wrong_answer: Jehoiada posts guards at the temple of the Lord.

data.Q: With whom does Jehoiada also make a covenant?
data.wrong_answer: The Lord with the king and people.

data.Q: Before the people kill Mattan, what do the people smash?
data.A: The people smash the altars and the idols.
data.wrong_answer: The people smash the temple of the Lord.
